cell_runs.summary: Registered project identities and one adjacent candidate were discovered without admission.
Current environment candidates were recorded without authority escalation.
Declared relationships were recorded as references, not vulnerabilities.
Discovery signals were separated from evidence admission.
Security interpretation consumed admitted observations only.
Rejected or stale signals did not become upgrade recommendations.
Bounded quality evidence was interpreted without a composite score.
A canonical-versus-live dependency audit conflict requires review.
Memory preserved temporal boundaries without inventing week-over-week change.
Human decision items were generated from bounded findings and blind spots.
Standalone HTML and Markdown were rendered from the standardized snapshot only.
